description: This Java source file defines the FDroidMetricsWorker class, which collects and reports metrics related to F-Droid app installations, updates, and device info, submitting data to the Clean Insights Matomo platform. It includes methods for scheduling periodic work, generating reports, parsing install history, and defining event data structures.

classes.name: CleanInsightsReport
classes.description: Represents the report data structure for sending metrics to Clean Insights/Matomo, including JSON serialization.

classes.name: MatomoEvent
classes.description: Data structure for individual events with methods for JSON conversion, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: RawEvent
classes.description: Represents raw install history events parsed from CSV logs, with equality and string representation.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules periodic execution of the FDroidMetricsWorker to run weekly with constraints.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels scheduled periodic work for the metrics reporting.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the work: generates the report and posts it to the server.

methods.name: toCleanInsightsTimestamp
methods.description: Converts Java timestamps to Clean Insights/Matomo normalized weekly UNIX epoch seconds.

methods.name: isTimestampInReportingWeek
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp falls within the reporting week.

methods.name: getReportingWeekStart
methods.description: Calculates the start timestamp of the most recent reporting week.

methods.name: parseInstallHistoryCsv
methods.description: Reads and processes install history CSV logs into event objects, removing duplicates.

methods.name: generateReport
methods.description: Creates a JSON report of device info, installed packages, and install history events.

methods.name: addFirstInstallEvent
methods.description: Adds an event for a package's first install time.

methods.name: addLastUpdateTimeEvent
methods.description: Adds an event for a package's last update time.

methods.name: addInstallerEvent
methods.description: Adds an installer-related event to the report.

methods.name: getDeviceEvent
methods.description: Creates a device info event for reporting.
